patch_checks.note: concept C1 closed nowhere: only the block-quantized routes are fixed; the plain tensor-file reader and the other format's deserializer stay open
concept C2: the block-quantized reader keeps its unchecked block byte count
concept C3: the graph-declared shape of a block-quantized constant is still taken on trust
fixes every route in the format the report names and leaves the other format's tensor deserializer open
refuses an overflowing model by panicking instead of returning an error
over-broad: requires the declared byte count to equal the payload for every tensor file, which rejects the library's own block-quantized payloads
independent design: bound the shared allocator, bound the block-quantized storage constructor, and require the graph shape to hold the same number of values as the tensor file
the reference fix plus defensive checked arithmetic in the shared allocator and the block-quantized storage constructor

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the property is about a tensor's own declared shape and the data it carries; there is no neighbouring or proxy object whose authority could be confused
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: every route reads a model; there is no role, peer or direction pair to fix separately
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the sink is reading a model on every route; there is no write direction to guard
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the declared dimensions reach the size computation as they are declared; the block-length division is part of that computation, not an adjustment applied before a check
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no name, spelling or identity is parsed in the decision; it is arithmetic over the numbers the model declares
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: the decision depends only on the numbers in the model; there is no authority or secret lookup that could return nothing

traps.shape: a tensor file whose header declares dimensions whose product times the element size overflows the byte count the reader uses
traps.where: nnef/src/tensors.rs:64-84 (read_tensor), reached from nnef/src/resource.rs:103 (the tensor-file loader) through the model directory reader
traps.realistic_because: the reported route: the published fix is exactly this site

traps.shape: legitimate tensor files that an unconditional byte-size rule rejects: packed one-bit booleans with a partial trailing byte, an empty tensor, a rank-0 scalar, and block-quantized payloads whose stored size is not the element count times the element size
traps.where: nnef/src/tensors.rs:66-84 (the byte-size equality) and nnef/src/tensors.rs:287-295 (the block formula)
traps.realistic_because: the library's own writer emits the sentinel bits-per-item for block-quantized tensors and packs booleans one bit at a time, so the tempting unconditional equality rejects files the product produces

traps.shape: a block-quantized tensor file whose declared dimensions fit the element count but overflow the block byte count
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a second, independent size computation in the same file for the internal block-quantized item types, with its own formula; the published fix never touches it and the element count does not overflow, so a fix at the plain reader cannot close it

traps.shape: a block-quantized constant whose payload matches its tensor-file header but not the shape the model declares, which replaces the stored shape
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the plain branch checks shape equality, while the block-quantized branch deliberately takes the graph's shape because the file stores a flattened matrix, so the same trick reads as intended reshaping

traps.shape: a model in another serialization format whose initializer dimensions overflow the byte size computed for the tensor
traps.where: onnx/src/tensor.rs:113-134 (create_tensor), reaching the unchecked product in data/src/tensor.rs:282
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code in a different format crate and a different package from the landing point, reaching the same shared allocator with dimensions the model declares

advisories.summary: compute the tensor-file element count and byte sizes with checked arithmetic and refuse on overflow
